targets.rawSql: WITH cycle AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target) target, time FROM metrics WHERE resource_type = 'kxn_scan' AND metric_name = 'rules_total' AND time > NOW() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY target, time DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scans s LEFT JOIN rules r ON s.rule_id = r.id JOIN cycle c ON c.target = s.target AND c.time = s.created_at WHERE s.error = true AND r.level = 3

WITH cycle AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target) target, time FROM metrics WHERE resource_type = 'kxn_scan' AND metric_name = 'rules_total' AND time > NOW() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY target, time DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scans s LEFT JOIN rules r ON s.rule_id = r.id JOIN cycle c ON c.target = s.target AND c.time = s.created_at WHERE s.error = true AND r.level = 2

WITH cycle AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target) target, time FROM metrics WHERE resource_type = 'kxn_scan' AND metric_name = 'rules_total' AND time > NOW() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY target, time DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scans s LEFT JOIN rules r ON s.rule_id = r.id JOIN cycle c ON c.target = s.target AND c.time = s.created_at WHERE s.error = true AND r.level = 1

WITH cycle AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target) target, time FROM metrics WHERE resource_type = 'kxn_scan' AND metric_name = 'rules_total' AND time > NOW() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY target, time DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scans s LEFT JOIN rules r ON s.rule_id = r.id JOIN cycle c ON c.target = s.target AND c.time = s.created_at WHERE s.error = true AND r.level = 0

SELECT date_trunc('minute', s.created_at) AS time, CASE r.level WHEN 3 THEN 'fatal' WHEN 2 THEN 'error' WHEN 1 THEN 'warning' WHEN 0 THEN 'info' ELSE 'unknown' END AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM scans s LEFT JOIN rules r ON s.rule_id = r.id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.created_at) AND s.error = true GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Findings by category (rule prefix, last cycle)

targets.rawSql: WITH cycle AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target) target, time FROM metrics WHERE resource_type = 'kxn_scan' AND metric_name = 'rules_total' AND time > NOW() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY target, time DESC) SELECT split_part(r.name, '-', 1) AS category, split_part(r.name, '-', 2) AS subcategory, COUNT(*) AS findings FROM scans s LEFT JOIN rules r ON s.rule_id = r.id JOIN cycle c ON c.target = s.target AND c.time = s.created_at WHERE s.error = true GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY findings DESC LIMIT 25

WITH cycle AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target) target, time FROM metrics WHERE resource_type = 'kxn_scan' AND metric_name = 'rules_total' AND time > NOW() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY target, time DESC), passed AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target) target, value_num AS passed FROM metrics WHERE resource_type = 'kxn_scan' AND metric_name = 'rules_passed' AND time > NOW() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY target, time DESC), found AS (SELECT s.target, r.level FROM scans s JOIN cycle c ON c.target = s.target AND c.time = s.created_at LEFT JOIN rules r ON s.rule_id = r.id WHERE s.error = true) SELECT target, COUNT(f.level) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 3) AS fatal, COUNT(f.level) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 2) AS error, COUNT(f.level) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 1) AS warning, MAX(p.passed) AS passed FROM passed p LEFT JOIN found f USING (target) GROUP BY target ORDER BY fatal DESC, error DESC
